en-US: Build 180: IDE GitHub Actions builds with App-owned job recovery and foreground polling; real document covers in Notes; added runtime lifecycle checks. Please test reopening during a long build, cancellation confirmation, logs and artifact downloads. In Notes, check Word/Excel/PowerPoint and DXF/DWG covers, rename and reopen. Check Node/Python preview service restart and environment deletion. Cloud builds use your own GitHub account; their Linux/macOS output is not an iOS executable. Office summaries are labelled when original-layout thumbnails are unavailable. Native Office/Pencil and the reported iPad local-model chat crash still need physical-device verification. No developer-funded cloud AI key is included. Report device, OS, model and shortest reproduction.
zh-Hans: Build 180：IDE 新增 GitHub Actions 云构建，由 App 保存任务、重开恢复及前台轮询；手记增加文档内容封面，补充运行时生命周期检查。请重点测试长构建期间重开、取消确认、日志与产物下载；手记中的 Word／Excel／PowerPoint 和 DXF／DWG 封面、重命名与重新打开；Node／Python 预览服务重启和环境删除。云构建使用自己的 GitHub 账户，Linux／macOS 产物不是 iOS 可执行程序。无法生成 Office 原始布局缩略图时会明确标记摘要。原生 Office／Pencil 和已报告的 iPad 本地模型聊天闪退仍需真机核验。此版本不附开发者付费云 AI Key。反馈请带设备、系统、模型和最短复现。
